title: Lyten Signs Exclusive MOU to Acquire Former Northvolt Gigafactory Site in Heide, Germany
detail: US battery startup Lyten signed an exclusive memorandum of understanding on July 1, 2026 to acquire the Northvolt Drei assets near Heide, Germany, alongside KfW (Germany's state-owned promotional bank), Northvolt Drei Project GmbH, and shareholder LG Batterie GmbH, at an agreed price of approximately €60 million. The 110-hectare brownfield site — where construction never began despite a 2024 groundbreaking — had already received power and utility infrastructure. Parties are targeting a definitive sales agreement in Q3 2026, subject to regulatory approval. Lyten plans a "significantly smaller" facility than Northvolt's original vision (roughly 1,000 jobs vs. 3,000 planned), combining battery cell production, energy storage systems, and a data center. This follows Lyten's completed acquisitions of Northvolt Ett (Skellefteå, Sweden) and Northvolt Labs (Västerås) in February 2026.
